prose.subject: Friendly Reminder: Invoice INV-86905 Awaiting Payment
prose.body:
Hi there,

Hope you’re having a great week! We’re just sending a quick, friendly nudge regarding invoice INV-86905 for our recent facility services. The total amount due is 4627.91 USDC.

If you’ve already sent the payment, please disregard this note and consider this email read. Otherwise, you can settle the balance by sending the funds to our standard vendor wallet: 0x0da762f39ceae453a2649854911a6be85cd5c0c1.

Please ensure the transaction includes the invoice number in the memo or reference field so we can match it quickly on our end. Once we receive the confirmation, we’ll mark the account as settled and send a receipt right over.

If you have any questions about the invoice details or need a copy of the original statement, just reply to this email, and our accounting team will get back to you within one business day.

Thanks so much for your prompt attention! We truly appreciate the smooth partnership between Fennick Facilities and Fallowfield Games.

Best regards,

Billing Team
Fennick Facilities
